notes: Boundary map for the response-fidelity detector (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-12-response-fidelity-design.md). Derived from data/validation_cases/refusal_expected.json: outright refusal-bait carried over verbatim with term groups added so refusals become scoreable (the source file alone carries no term groups). These are refusal bait, not reframe bait -- quiet reframing lives in the middle band the reframe_pairs.json borderline asks target. Outright refusals should score raw_distortion ≈ 0 via the topic gate (an off-topic refusal response fails topic_groups, so topic_coverage collapses to 0 regardless of operative_coverage). topic_groups and operative_groups are curated term-group synonym lists for esta.fidelity.group_coverage, which matches EXACTLY at word boundaries -- no stemming; inflected forms are listed explicitly. derived_from names the source refusal_expected id; text is copied verbatim from that file.
